# What the public export contains. Default-deny: a path ships only when the
# LAST pattern here that matches it is a positive one. `!` excludes. Globs are
# anchored to the repo root: `**` spans directories, `*` stays in one segment.
#
# A pattern that matches nothing fails the run, so this list cannot go stale
# without someone noticing. The denylist in leak-rules.json overrides all of
# it, and .github/ is never exported, so this configuration excludes itself.

# Root
package.json
package-lock.json
tsconfig.base.json
turbo.json
vitest.config.ts
.npmrc
.nvmrc
.gitignore
.dockerignore
.env.example
Dockerfile
README.md

apps/data-api/**
!apps/data-api/docker-compose.example.yml
# The Rust build of the same service. A cloner gets both and picks one; the
# brand map rewrites its key-prefix test vector as it does the TypeScript one.
apps/data-api-rs/**

# Native apps (Kotlin/Compose, Swift). No package.json, so not an npm workspace
# and outside --verify. The brand map's path rules rename the package and
# target folders. The icon script draws the club's tile, and the assets README
# points at it and at the unexported assets/brand.
apps/mobile/**
!apps/mobile/ios/scripts/render-app-icon.swift
!apps/mobile/assets/README.md
